# Composition Science Repository Governance Specification

---
title: Composition Science Repository Governance Specification
id: GOV-002
document_type: governance
project: Composition Science
version: 1.0
status: draft
date: 2026-07-21
---

## Mission

Maintain a reproducible, evidence-based repository that multiple autonomous agents can safely extend.

## Workflow

Research Session
→ Scientific Journal
→ Research Execution Package (REP)
→ Repository Updates
→ Knowledge Graph Updates
→ Published Outputs

No permanent change bypasses an REP.

## Artifact Lifecycle

Draft → Working → Review → Approved → Archived

## Stable IDs

GOV, RP, JR, GN, ONT, LAW, HY, EV, EX, MET, CASE

## Theory Promotion

Hypothesis → Candidate Law → Engineering Principle → Theory

Promotion requires independent evidence, falsification attempts, limitations, and theory impact analysis.

## Required REP Updates

- Theory Registry
- Evidence Registry
- Knowledge Graph
- Genome
- Ontology

## Conflict Resolution

Preserve conflicting evidence until resolved.

## Agent Rules

Read the Constitution.
Use ontology IDs.
Update graph relationships.
Never overwrite history.
Never hide uncertainty.

## Repository Health

- Traceable evidence
- Stable IDs
- No orphan concepts
- Reproducible reasoning

## Next Deliverables

1. Research Protocol
2. Theory Registry
3. Evidence Registry
4. Hypothesis Registry
5. Graph validation tools
